reviews.text:
My favorite clinic ♥️
Here we are again at the Eoure clinic, where our rabbits and other animals are cared for with love, professionalism, and dedication.

Besides being a very good clinic, the atmosphere is very pleasant, with a smiling, humorous team who are always there when we need them!

Just so you know: they're not exotic animal specialists, but you can go there with your eyes closed (except for spiders and snakes 😁😂).

Our rabbits are delighted to be in the hands of Dr. Verne and the entire team.

Plus, Caroline, the veterinary assistant, is a bird lover 🥰

They are now fully equipped for rabbits: hay, treats, force-feeding, hoof trimming... They are ready to care for your bunnies in any situation.

Annette,
President of Annette's Refuge

Everything came together perfectly: a wonderful, caring, and incredibly competent team!
A very successful operation on a 10-year-old cat with a dental abscess, treated with cortisone! A huge thank you to you and to the kind staff at reception.

Thank you for your feedback.
We wish Blum a speedy recovery and hope she is calm in the coming days.

Excellent veterinary clinic! A professional, gentle, and attentive team. You can tell that the well-being of the animals is a real priority. I highly recommend them!

Thank you for taking such good care of my dog ​​Yuri 🐕

A huge thank you to Dr. Verne, a truly remarkable woman who knows how to care for our animals and for us. She is incredibly compassionate and extraordinary in difficult times. A big thank you to her first and foremost, and to us as well. Your red eyes touched me deeply; thank you for everything, you are an extraordinary person.
A friendly and professional clinic, clean and excellent staff, thank you, I highly recommend it.
The team is lovely, always available, and more than competent (my pets are prone to complicated illnesses, so I know what I'm talking about 😅). Your pets will be pampered! …
Excellent clinic… they really take great care of our animals… and are very conscientious.
Excellent veterinarians, top-notch care for dogs, competence, and advice. They know how to take their time. Highly recommended.

Hello,
Thank you for your feedback
All the staff there are attentive and very professional. I recommend this veterinary clinic.

A superb veterinary clinic for your pet, and especially Dr. Verne, who is fantastic and very caring. She knows how to put your pet at ease by giving excellent advice.

Not forgetting her veterinary assistant, who is also very caring and offers great advice on your pet's diet.
My dog ​​Lili (Beagle) wags her tail when she approaches the clinic and greets them enthusiastically as soon as she sees them.
Don't hesitate to consult them for your pet.
A top-notch team in a top-notch clinic.
Cheers, Lili
Excellent clinic! Very welcoming staff

Excellent care at the Clinique vétérinaire des Éoures. The veterinarians and veterinary nurses combine extensive clinical expertise with remarkable gentleness and attentiveness. The welcome is warm, the facilities are spotless, and explanations are always clear and transparent, from diagnosis to follow-up. A level of professionalism and empathy rarely seen in Marseille; I recommend them without hesitation.
Go ahead, don't hesitate: they're great! Kind and efficient, gentle and effective. Our little cat, Poé, is in good hands.
Thank you ❤️

Very satisfied with this establishment. The reception staff were very welcoming, and of course, all the staff were excellent. Finally, Ms. Agathe Gauvin was very professional and attentive, giving good advice. I highly recommend this veterinarian and her team.

Hello,
I recently had to use the Eoures clinic for my daughter's rabbit: all the staff were very welcoming and caring, answering all my questions.
I felt a genuine desire to help and provide good care for my pet.
The staff is young, dynamic, and proactive.
I recommend this clinic.
It seems (though I didn't know this when I went) that the current staff recently took over the clinic, and that the reputation of their predecessors wasn't very good.
I can confirm that things have changed considerably since then, and for the better!

As president of a shelter for exotic pets, specifically rabbits, we first encountered Dr. Verne in the emergency room at V2tu. We reconnected with her after she rescued Mira, a rabbit we took in.

To tell you the story—because it deserves to be told—Dr. Verne kept Mira with her day and night for a week, taking her everywhere she went to keep a close eye on her. This little rabbit, hit by a car, was incredibly lucky to have met her, and since then, we see Dr. Verne twice a week for our bunny care. 😍

A clinic with a big heart, capable of spending 2.5 hours in consultation. She's always ready to find the problem, come back, send us a message at midnight if she has a sudden insight, and see us in an emergency when we've needed her. This is a clinic where both the doctor and the veterinary assistants always treat our little companions with great love, respect, and professionalism, and we entrust them to them without hesitation.

I highly recommend it, on every level, and after working with many veterinarians and clinics, it's one of our favorites for all the reasons I mentioned above.

I should also mention that you can go there for your rabbits' spaying/neutering with complete peace of mind, even though the doctor isn't a specialist in exotic pets, because their expertise is beyond question.

♥️👊🐰

Excellent veterinary clinic; the assistants and vets are lovely. I take my two rabbits there, and they've always been very well cared for (it's hard to find a clinic that takes good care of exotic pets). I highly recommend it!
Excellent clinic. Top-notch care. The vet is professional, gentle, and takes the time to explain things. Passionate team.

Absolutely fantastic!! The doctors and the veterinary assistants were wonderful.

I had to bring my rabbit in once for a minor case of conjunctivitis and a second time for intestinal congestion.

They aren't exotic animal specialists, but all the necessary care and check-ups were done with great kindness, explanations, and support. They even contacted me to check on my little one and her progress with the treatment.
I highly recommend this dedicated, professional, and very caring veterinary clinic.

Thank you!

<3

A fantastic experience fostering my pets, especially rabbits and a kitten. They always took excellent care of them, were very competent and friendly, and their prices were fair. I highly recommend them!

Since the change of ownership, this clinic has become excellent for exotic pets. They are professional and technically skilled. They took care of my rabbit and saved him from major surgery by correcting the damage caused by a previous procedure that went wrong at another clinic.
Excellent clinic

Dr. Verne and his team are incredible… a far cry from the big, impersonal clinics that often only care about profit! Reasonable prices, a genuine love for animals, and expert advice on care and behavior! Go there with complete confidence!

I highly recommend this clinic.
Our Australian Shepherd is seen by Pauline Verne, who is absolutely fantastic! 👌🏻😁 Thank you! …

An incredibly kind and caring team.

We were treated for our little cat, Moka, and we want to express our deepest gratitude to Dr. Gauvin. She demonstrated great gentleness, immense kindness, and exceptional listening skills during what was a particularly stressful time for us.

Moka required some rather specific treatment, and Dr. Gauvin and Dr. Verne supported us throughout this ordeal with great care and professionalism. They took excellent care of him, but also of us, understanding our worries and taking the time to reassure us and explain each step.

Thank you for your availability, your empathy, and your dedication to our little warrior. Your support meant the world to us.
Thank you so much
Top-notch vets! Very professional and attentive to the well-being of animals. They were very patient with my dog ​​despite his fear and a bad experience with another vet. I highly recommend them! 👍 …

It's hard to find good vets.

GO THERE DIRECTLY! Dr. Verne has been a constant presence for my 12-year-old dog ever since he started having problems. She's been in touch via messages, emails, and phone calls, explaining everything! She's truly amazing. I just wish I'd known about her sooner!
They also offer osteopathic consultations; Mylène is wonderful.

I came in yesterday for my little Akira 🐈's vaccination, and I received a very warm welcome from the whole team. They all complimented Akira so much! 🥰 Dr. Pauline Verne was wonderful, very reassuring, answered all my questions, and really put me at ease… she was so gentle with Akira, who was exhausted after her vaccination 😂 I'm so glad she's taking such good care of her and delighted to now be one of your patients. It's great to see vets who take the time to talk to us and give us advice.

For me, this is one of the best veterinary clinics in Marseille, if not the best.

I brought my cat here after another clinic told me he was doomed and needed to be put down, without clearly explaining what was wrong with him or if there was any chance of saving him. I was asked to make a decision quickly, which I refused to do. I preferred to get a second opinion, and this clinic was recommended to me. From the moment we arrived, I was pleasantly surprised, both by the veterinarian and the entire team. They are incredibly kind, attentive, and above all, very compassionate. You can genuinely feel that they love animals, and especially cats.

The veterinarian has a huge heart. She did everything she could to understand what was wrong with my cat, with great gentleness, patience, and kindness, both towards him and towards me. At the first clinic, my cat was terrified, stressed, and anxious, to the point of urinating several times out of fear. At the Éoures clinic, he was much calmer and more at ease, which speaks volumes. As for the prices, they are more than reasonable, and the staff is exceptionally caring. Having previously disliked veterinarians because I often found them cold, impersonal, and only interested in money, this clinic has restored my faith in the profession. I recommend them wholeheartedly. Thank you to the entire team for your compassion and for taking Sanka in as an emergency patient.
I took my cat Get to the clinic. Dr. Gauvin took care of him; she was super patient and gentle!
Super friendly and incredibly patient team, despite my little one's stratospheric stress levels and his stubbornness. A huge thank you ♥️
Thank you for your feedback.
Top-notch veterinarians

A huge thank you to the entire veterinary team for taking such wonderful care of our two beloved pets, Lily and Angel. ❤️
You guided them with gentleness, patience, and kindness, always attentive and present in both joyful and difficult moments.
A very special thank you to Dr. Gauvin for his compassionate and humane support until Angel's very last moment…
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your dedication and for all the love you put into your work.

The entire team is very professional, caring, attentive, and competent. The welcome is warm. They provide prompt service and are always available for our animals. I highly recommend this clinic and it deserves to be better known.

Top-notch team.
Very professional and attentive to both the owner and the animal.
They took excellent care of my dog ​​😊

I highly recommend them 👍🏼
Professionals who listen to both the animal and the owner! Clean clinic, highly recommended!
Perfect team, attentive to their patients. Thank you 🫶🏻 …

A great team, very attentive and professional.
I highly recommend them.
Excellent clinic, I highly recommend it.
A fantastic team who are so attentive to us and our dogs. Thank you for everything!
Thank you to Dr. Verne for quickly taking care of my Loki's eye, and for the dental trimming of my Goliath (rabbits) 😊 Friendly, kind and professional, I recommend this clinic and its team! …

A huge thank you to the entire team for taking such good care of my dog ​​during her spaying. I was very stressed, but as always, you were incredibly kind, attentive, and professional. You reassured me from beginning to end, and my sweet girl was pampered with amazing gentleness. 💕 You are truly a fantastic team—competent, attentive, and deeply caring. I trust you completely! 🙏🐶
Xena

An exceptional team that deserves to be known and recognized.

The Eoures veterinary clinic is exceptional. Dr. Verne, her veterinary assistant Caroline, and the entire team are highly competent, caring, and always available. I take both my dog ​​and my rabbits there, and I have always been welcomed with great attentiveness and professionalism. Dr. Verne's experience in emergency clinics is evident in her responsiveness and thoroughness. She takes remarkable care of my dog ​​Mya and my rabbits, who require specialized expertise. A passionate and trustworthy team that I recommend without hesitation.

Mélanie

A great clinic, the staff is competent, pleasant, and attentive.
My animals have been monitored for several months, and I'm delighted.
Thank you for your professionalism.

It's a shame I can't give zero stars...
My mother came in earlier this week for an emergency. We have a cat who comes to our garden every summer to enjoy the sun. We found him in agonizing condition in our garden with a huge open wound. The staff politely asked us to wait until everyone else was seen, then kindly sold us cat food at the counter. The cat was in extreme pain; he needed to be put out of it. I find it outrageous that they didn't prioritize the cat's health while he was in agony, I repeat, before or between the other patients.

And for your information: the cat died while my mother was waiting "her turn." I can't even imagine the pain he endured.
Don't go to this clinic if your pet is seriously unwell.
Believe me, I would NEVER take my dog ​​there.

Excellent veterinary clinic. A top-notch team in every way. A warm welcome for us and our four-legged companions. Kind, pleasant, and always offering sound advice with excellent diagnoses. My dog ​​comes for her appointments without fear or stress. And there's always a little treat as a gift.

New team at the clinic, and what a team!

Three incredibly professional and attentive veterinarians. Thank you for the warm welcome and the smiles.
This change will be a real boon for the entire Eoures Camoins neighborhood.
I highly recommend them.
THANKS

Thank you for your warm welcome and courtesy.
Your attentiveness and gentleness towards Bamboo (a 9-year-old European Shorthair cat) were truly appreciated.

I will return with confidence at the end of September to check the effectiveness of the treatment.
Have a good weekend.
Anne Desponts

Thank you to Dr. Verne and Caroline for their professionalism, support, and love for animals.

Pauline is a fantastic vet with a very insightful analytical mind, extensive medical knowledge, and quick response time. She always provided the support I needed, even when things weren't easy.

Happy and Vaïana thank you for everything you do every day, for your dedication and kindness. ❣️

I highly recommend this amazing team!

I thank Dr. Pauline Verne and her assistant Caroline for their dedication to our animals and their owners. They are highly competent and caring professionals. I highly recommend the Éoures veterinary clinic.

Fantastic new team in Eoures with gentle and effective care. My cat Câline had gastritis... treated in just a few days, she's back to chasing everything that moves in the garden. I highly recommend this clinic!
It's a pleasure to deal with true healthcare professionals who are competent, honest, and empathetic. I highly recommend them.
A top-notch clinic 😊 A competent team, attentive to pet owners, and providing excellent care for their four-legged patients …

Responsiveness, kindness, and professionalism are the hallmarks of Eoures' CV.
Thank you again for everything!

Thank you both for your professionalism and kindness. We are so happy to have you in the neighborhood; we neighbors all talk about you! Praline and Pastaga also thank you. We're going away for a little while, but we'll be back soon!
Go for it, they're great at that clinic!!!!

I want to thank Pauline and Caroline from the bottom of my heart; they are two simply exceptional veterinarians. Their professionalism, gentleness, and dedication transform each visit into a moment of trust and serenity.

They always take the time to listen, explain clearly, and provide care with rare attention. Their love for animals is palpable, and it shows in every gesture, every glance. You feel you are in very good hands.

Thank you both so much for your kindness, competence, and humanity. You are a wonderful duo, and I feel incredibly lucky to be able to count on you to look after my little Venus.

❤️

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Eours Veterinary Clinic, Caroline and Dr. Verne, who are simply exceptional! 🐾💙

Kind, caring, and passionate about their work… They have created a truly nurturing and trusting environment. Even for a simple vaccination, we leave feeling reassured, calm… and with a smile (both us and our four-legged companions) 🐶🐱

It's a real pleasure to be able to rely on such compassionate and dedicated professionals. Thank you for everything you do 🙏
Thank you for the warm welcome and excellent care. Finally, a professional AND very friendly team :-)

We would like to thank Dr. Verne and Caroline for their professionalism and the excellent care they provided for our cat Yuki, as well as their warm welcome at every visit to their veterinary clinic. We highly recommend them.

A huge thank you to Dr. Verne and Caroline for all the care they gave Mirka. After saving her when she was thought to be doomed following an infection, they now provide her with kindness, efficiency, and professionalism, relieving her arthritis problems.

I wanted to thank the clinic team for the emergency first visit for my cat. Kudos to Dr. Pauline Verne and her assistant, who were very professional, available, and welcoming. Skyti will, of course, come back to you with complete confidence. I highly recommend them!

A fantastic young, dynamic, and caring team for our animal friends!
A wonderful discovery in our lovely neighborhood and a real blessing for our dogs to have such kind people looking after them. It's rare to find such kind and competent caregivers. I wholeheartedly recommend this new veterinary clinic. Thank you for your professionalism and kindness.

A very professional and conscientious team! I brought my dog ​​in for stomach problems; he was kept on an IV drip overnight. We received updates and photos during his "hospitalization."

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

Competence, professionalism, kindness, and availability.
We are reassured to know we can count on you!

I wanted to express my great satisfaction following the first visit.

The welcome was perfect, and you immediately put Milo at ease.

He is very happy, and so am I!

I wish you all the best for the future.
And I highly recommend this clinic.
A huge thank you to the whole team and to Dr. Verne for taking such good care of our Minette, who is now in excellent health. Fantastic team and a wonderful welcome!
Fantastic team, very welcoming. They are very attentive to the animals but also to the stress of their owners. Highly competent and a very clean clinic.
THANKS

Fantastic find!

We're thrilled to have finally found a veterinarian who combines kindness, compassion, and competence.

We went there for our little dog's vaccination, as he can be quite difficult at the vet's, which sometimes leads to us being treated poorly and feeling rather embarrassed.

This is the first time we've experienced the complete opposite: no judgment from the team, who took excellent care of our dog and gave us the best possible advice.
It's such a relief to have finally found THE perfect veterinary clinic!
Thank you again!

Dr. Verne is very competent and attentive to the needs of our furry friends. She gives excellent advice and treats our animals with gentleness and kindness. Dr. Verne saved one of my cats, and it wasn't a sure thing; I trust her completely.

Caroline is a fantastic veterinary assistant who is also attentive and empathetic.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

A fantastic new veterinary team! We were able to get our Fleur back, and she's in perfect health! It's reassuring to know our animals are being cared for so well and with so much love. We will remain loyal customers. Thank you so much!

If you want a quick appointment and top-notch care for your furry friend, then you've come to the right place! A huge thank you to Dr. Verne, Caro, and Agathe for their kindness, efficiency, and availability!!
Mel, Axel, and Rooky
THANKS

I took my little Rio to the emergency vet after he was bitten by another dog. He was seen very quickly, and the team was incredibly warm and reassuring. Dr. Verne and Caroline are wonderful people; I thank them for everything! Go there without hesitation, with complete confidence!

First consultation for my Shiba Inu at this newly opened veterinary clinic, and I highly recommend it. A warm welcome, Dr. Verne and her staff are fantastic, gentle and reassuring, with clear explanations for your pet's well-being.
A huge thank you to Dr. Verne who took such wonderful care of my little cat! She's back in perfect health! And she's eager to play. I commend the professionalism and kindness of the entire team.

A dynamic, caring, attentive, and professional team.
Pauline had already looked after my cats. When she opened the D'Eoures clinic, it was obvious to me to follow her, given her skills, professionalism, and compassionate advice. She has a deep love for animals.
She is a natural veterinarian because animal welfare is more than just a job for her.

In fact, her resume states that she worked as an emergency veterinarian, which speaks volumes about her dedication.
To date, Pauline has cared for my three cats, whom I've had at various times in my life.

And a big thank you to Caroline, who is lovely and professional at reception and also assists with treatments. She also worked as an emergency veterinarian, so I have complete confidence in this team.

A huge thank you to Caroline and Dr. Verne for the care they gave my little dog.
She's doing so much better since her visit to your clinic. 🐕♥️♥️ …
I thank the whole team, great welcome 🙏 …

Fantastic team: responsive, available, and caring.
Highly recommended for all pet owners in the 11th arrondissement and surrounding areas.

Excellent care for my little one, Dr. Verne and his team are fantastic!
A huge thank you!

Delighted with the reopening of the clinic and a fantastic new team...with impeccable professionalism. Thank you to Caroline, Dr. Verne, and Agathe.

Sylvain and Rio 🐾

Top-notch clinic! Dr. Verne and his nurse Caroline are truly wonderful, always taking such good care of our animals, it's so reassuring 🥰

Thank you for being there for our furry friends 🙏🏻
